#Phyloseq
```{r}
# Ensure correct object classes
taxfileS <- as.matrix(taxfileS)
mapfileS <- as.data.frame(mapfileS)
ASVsS <- as.matrix(ASVsS)

# Create phyloseq object
phy_mw <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(ASVsS, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(taxfileS),
  sample_data(mapfileS)
)

# Remove non-bacterial contaminants and singletons
phy_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_taxa(
    Kingdom == "Bacteria" &
      Family != "Mitochondria" &
      Order != "Chloroplast"
  ) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 1, .)

# Standardize sample_type metadata
sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type <- sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type |>
  as.character() |>
  trimws() |>
  tolower() |>
  factor(levels = c("colon", "cloaca"))

# Save cleaned full object
saveRDS(phy_mw, file = "phy_mw_clean_full.rds")

# Extract turtle ID from sample names and subset to EI < 49
ei_num <- as.numeric(sub("^EI([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_names(phy_mw)))

phy_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  prune_samples(ei_num < 49, .) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)

# Save filtered object
saveRDS(phy_mw, file = "phy_mw_pre49.rds")

phy_mw

```


#Rarefaction at 70k reads & Alpha Diversity 
```{r}
set.seed(42)

rar_70k <- rarefy_even_depth(
  phy_mw,
  sample.size = 70000,
  rngseed = 42,
  replace = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

rar_70k <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rar_70k) > 0, rar_70k)

table(sample_data(rar_70k)$sample_type)
length(unique(sample_data(rar_70k)$turtle_ID))

#rstrict to complete pairs
meta_70k <- as(sample_data(rar_70k), "data.frame")

complete_ids <- meta_70k %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_ID") %>%
  count(turtle_ID) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(turtle_ID)

rar_70k <- subset_samples(rar_70k, turtle_ID %in% complete_ids)
rar_70k <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rar_70k) > 0, rar_70k)

##ALPHA
# Alpha diversity — 70,000 reads

# 1. Calculate alpha-diversity metrics from 70k rarefied data

alpha_70k <- estimate_richness(
  rar_70k,
  measures = c(
    "Observed",
    "Shannon",
    "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_ID")


# 2. Add sample metadata

meta_70k_df <- as(
  sample_data(rar_70k),
  "data.frame"
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_ID")


alpha_70k_df <- alpha_70k %>%
  left_join(
    meta_70k_df,
    by = "sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_type %in% c(
      "colon",
      "cloaca"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleType = factor(
      as.character(sample_type),
      levels = c(
        "colon",
        "cloaca"
      )
    ),
    turtle_ID = factor(
      as.character(turtle_ID)
    )
  )


# 3. Confirm paired structure and retain complete pairs

pair_check_70k <- alpha_70k_df %>%
  count(
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SampleType,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )


complete_pair_ids_70k <- pair_check_70k %>%
  filter(
    colon == 1,
    cloaca == 1
  ) %>%
  pull(turtle_ID)


alpha_70k_df <- alpha_70k_df %>%
  filter(
    turtle_ID %in% complete_pair_ids_70k
  )


cat(
  "Number of complete turtle pairs at 70,000 reads:",
  length(complete_pair_ids_70k),
  "\n"
)

print(
  table(alpha_70k_df$SampleType)
)


stopifnot(
  length(complete_pair_ids_70k) > 0,
  all(
    c("colon", "cloaca") %in%
      levels(alpha_70k_df$SampleType)
  )
)


# 4. Create wide table for paired statistical testing

alpha_wide_70k <- alpha_70k_df %>%
  select(
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType,
    Observed,
    Shannon,
    Simpson
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SampleType,
    values_from = c(
      Observed,
      Shannon,
      Simpson
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na()


cat(
  "Complete pairs used in statistical tests at 70,000 reads:",
  nrow(alpha_wide_70k),
  "\n"
)


# 5. Create long table for plotting and summaries

metric_levels <- c(
  "Observed",
  "Shannon",
  "Simpson"
)


alpha_long_70k <- alpha_70k_df %>%
  select(
    sample_ID,
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType,
    all_of(metric_levels)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_levels),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = metric_levels
    )
  )


# 6. Calculate medians, quartiles and IQRs

alpha_summary_70k <- alpha_long_70k %>%
  group_by(
    Metric,
    SampleType
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Value)),

    Median = median(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Q1 = stats::quantile(
      Value,
      probs = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),

    Q3 = stats::quantile(
      Value,
      probs = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),

    IQR = stats::IQR(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(alpha_summary_70k)


# 7. Function for paired Wilcoxon tests and effect sizes
# +1 = all non-zero paired differences favour cloaca
# -1 = all non-zero paired differences favour colon

paired_alpha_summary_70k <- function(
    colon_values,
    cloaca_values,
    metric_name
) {

  keep <- complete.cases(
    colon_values,
    cloaca_values
  )

  colon_values <- colon_values[keep]
  cloaca_values <- cloaca_values[keep]

  paired_difference <-
    cloaca_values - colon_values

  nonzero_difference <-
    paired_difference[
      paired_difference != 0
    ]

  if (length(nonzero_difference) == 0) {

    rank_biserial <- 0

  } else {

    signed_ranks <- rank(
      abs(nonzero_difference),
      ties.method = "average"
    )

    positive_rank_sum <- sum(
      signed_ranks[
        nonzero_difference > 0
      ]
    )

    negative_rank_sum <- sum(
      signed_ranks[
        nonzero_difference < 0
      ]
    )

    rank_biserial <- (
      positive_rank_sum -
        negative_rank_sum
    ) / (
      positive_rank_sum +
        negative_rank_sum
    )
  }

  wilcox_output <- wilcox.test(
    x = cloaca_values,
    y = colon_values,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )

  tibble(
    Metric = metric_name,
    n_pairs = length(colon_values),

    Colon_median = median(
      colon_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Colon_Q1 = quantile(
      colon_values,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Colon_Q3 = quantile(
      colon_values,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Colon_IQR = IQR(
      colon_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Cloaca_median = median(
      cloaca_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Cloaca_Q1 = quantile(
      cloaca_values,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Cloaca_Q3 = quantile(
      cloaca_values,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Cloaca_IQR = IQR(
      cloaca_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Median_paired_difference = median(
      paired_difference,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Wilcoxon_V = unname(
      wilcox_output$statistic
    ),

    p_value = wilcox_output$p.value,

    Rank_biserial = rank_biserial
  )
}


# 8. Run paired tests for all metrics

alpha_stats_70k <- bind_rows(

  paired_alpha_summary_70k(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Observed_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Observed_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Observed"
  ),

  paired_alpha_summary_70k(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Shannon_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Shannon_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Shannon"
  ),

  paired_alpha_summary_70k(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Simpson_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide_70k$Simpson_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    BH_adjusted_p = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),

    Significance = case_when(
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.001  ~ "***",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.01   ~ "**",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE                   ~ "ns"
    ),

    Effect_magnitude = case_when(
      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.10 ~
        "Negligible",

      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.30 ~
        "Small",

      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.50 ~
        "Moderate",

      TRUE ~
        "Large"
    ),

    Effect_direction = case_when(
      Rank_biserial > 0 ~
        "Higher in cloaca",

      Rank_biserial < 0 ~
        "Higher in colon",

      TRUE ~
        "No directional effect"
    )
  )


print(alpha_stats_70k)


# 9. Save paired differences for each turtle

alpha_paired_differences_70k <- alpha_wide_70k %>%
  transmute(
    turtle_ID,

    Observed_colon,
    Observed_cloaca,
    Observed_difference =
      Observed_cloaca -
      Observed_colon,

    Shannon_colon,
    Shannon_cloaca,
    Shannon_difference =
      Shannon_cloaca -
      Shannon_colon,

    Simpson_colon,
    Simpson_cloaca,
    Simpson_difference =
      Simpson_cloaca -
      Simpson_colon
  )


# 10. Prepare BH-adjusted figure annotations

annotation_df_70k <- alpha_long_70k %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    value_min = min(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    value_max = max(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    value_range =
      value_max - value_min,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value_range = if_else(
      value_range == 0,
      abs(value_max) * 0.10 + 0.01,
      value_range
    ),

    y_position =
      value_max +
      0.10 * value_range
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    alpha_stats_70k %>%
      transmute(
        Metric = factor(
          Metric,
          levels = metric_levels
        ),
        Significance,
        BH_adjusted_p
      ),
    by = "Metric"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_label = case_when(
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.001 ~
        paste0(
          Significance,
          "\nBH p < 0.001"
        ),

      TRUE ~
        paste0(
          Significance,
          "\nBH p = ",
          formatC(
            BH_adjusted_p,
            format = "f",
            digits = 3
          )
        )
    )
  )


print(annotation_df_70k)
```

#Beta Diversity
##Aitchision
```{r}
##  Aitchison distance (CLR-transformed ASV table)

# Subset to colon and cloaca samples only
phy_beta_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca")) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)

# Basic checks
stopifnot(sum(is.na(sample_data(phy_beta_mw)$sample_type)) == 0)
stopifnot(nsamples(phy_beta_mw) == 96)

# CLR transform
phy_beta_mw_clr <- microbiome::transform(
  phy_beta_mw,
  transform = "clr"
)

# Extract CLR matrix (samples × ASVs)
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(phy_beta_mw_clr), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(phy_beta_mw_clr)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

stopifnot(identical(rownames(otu_mat), sample_names(phy_beta_mw_clr)))

# Aitchison distance
dist_aitch_mw <- dist(otu_mat, method = "euclidean")

# Metadata
meta_mw <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_beta_mw_clr))

# PERMANOVA (paired design blocked by turtle_ID)
set.seed(42)
adonis_aitch_mw <- adonis2(
  dist_aitch_mw ~ sample_type,
  data = meta_mw,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_mw$turtle_ID
)

adonis_aitch_mw

# Homogeneity of dispersion
set.seed(42)
disp_aitch_mw <- betadisper(dist_aitch_mw, meta_mw$sample_type)
permutest(disp_aitch_mw, permutations = 999)
anova(disp_aitch_mw)

## PCA for visualization
ord <- prcomp(otu_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
eig <- ord$sdev^2 / sum(ord$sdev^2) * 100

# Clean sample type labels
clean_sample_type <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("\u00A0", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
    trimws() %>%
    tolower()
}

# Sample scores
df_plot <- data.frame(
  sample_ID = rownames(otu_mat),
  turtle_ID = meta_mw$turtle_ID,
  PC1 = ord$x[, 1],
  PC2 = ord$x[, 2],
  sample_type = meta_mw$sample_type
) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleType = factor(
      clean_sample_type(sample_type),
      levels = c("colon", "cloaca")
    )
  )

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(nrow(df_plot) == 96)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(df_plot$SampleType)) == 0)

# PCA loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(ord$rotation) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_beta_mw_clr)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Select top genus/family drivers
# Select top genus/family drivers
top_taxa <- loadings %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tax, by = "ASV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Genus  = ifelse(tolower(Genus) %in% c("unclassified", "unknown", ""), NA, Genus),
    Family = ifelse(tolower(Family) %in% c("unclassified", "unknown", ""), NA, Family),
    label  = ifelse(!is.na(Genus), Genus, Family),
    label  = stringr::str_replace_all(label, "_", " ")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(label)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(label) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = abs(PC1),
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(PC1))) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 6)

# Scale arrows for plotting
arrow_mult <- quantile(abs(c(df_plot$PC1, df_plot$PC2)), 0.9) * 8

top_taxa <- top_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_plot = PC1 * arrow_mult,
    PC2_plot = PC2 * arrow_mult
  )

# Plot
p_MW <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = SampleType),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = SampleType),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = top_taxa,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_plot, yend = PC2_plot),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = top_taxa,
    aes(x = PC1_plot, y = PC2_plot, label = label),
    size = 3.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = NA,
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    max.overlaps = 50,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "colon"  = "#009E73",
      "cloaca" = "#7B4EA3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = NULL, 
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(eig[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(eig[2], 1), "%)"),
    colour = "Sample type"
  )

p_MW

# Save figure
# PNG — Frontiers submission version
ggsave(
  "Figure_3_Aitchison_PCA_colon_cloacaF.png",
  plot = p_MW,
  width = 180,
  height = 145,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# PDF — vector master
ggsave(
  "Figure_3_Aitchison_PCA_colon_cloacaF.pdf",

  height = 145,
  units = "mm",
  bg = "white"
)

# SVG — editable vector master

  "Figure_3_Aitchison_PCA_colon_cloacaF.svg",

  left_join(tax, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus),

    abs_PC2 = abs(PC2)
  ) %>%
```

#Taxonomy
##Phyla

```{r}

phy_phylum <- phy_mw %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum", NArm = FALSE)

# Convert to relative abundance
phy_phylum_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy_phylum, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Melt to long format and clean labels
df_phylum <- psmelt(phy_phylum_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = as.character(Phylum),
    Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Unclassified", Phylum),
    sample_type = tolower(trimws(as.character(sample_type)))
  )

## Color palette
base_pastel <- c(
  "#9AD0EC", "#FBC4AB", "#B5EAD7", "#FFAFCC", "#CDB4DB",
  "#E4C1F9", "#FFF1A8", "#CED4DA", "#BEE7E8", "#FFD6A5",
  "#CAFFBF", "#FDFFB6", "#FFC6FF", "#BDB2FF", "#EAE4E9",
  "#F1FAEE", "#E9C46A", "#F4A261", "#84A59D", "#B8F2E6"
)

## Top phyla for plotting
topN <- 10

top_phyla <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

df_phylum <- df_phylum %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum_plot = ifelse(Phylum %in% top_phyla, Phylum, "Other")
  )

phyla_levels <- sort(unique(df_phylum$Phylum_plot))
phyla_levels <- phyla_levels[phyla_levels != "Other"]

phyla_colors <- setNames(
  base_pastel[seq_along(phyla_levels)],
  phyla_levels
)

phyla_colors <- c(phyla_colors, Other = "grey85")
phyla_colors["Pseudomonadota"] <- "#8DA0CB"

## Mean composition by sample type
df_phylum_mean <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_type, Phylum_plot) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Phylum_plot) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

p_phylum_mean <- ggplot(
  df_phylum_mean,
  aes(x = sample_type, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum_plot)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phyla_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("colon", "cloaca")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Phylum-level gut microbiome composition (mean)",
    subtitle = paste0("Top ", topN, " phyla; remaining collapsed as Other"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean relative abundance",
    fill = "Phylum"
  )

ggsave(
  "MW_Phylum_mean_colon_vs_cloaca.png",
  p_phylum_mean,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 400
)

ggsave(
  "MW_Phylum_mean_colon_vs_cloaca.svg",
  p_phylum_mean,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)

## Per-sample composition
df_phylum_ind <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_type, turtle_ID, Phylum_plot) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    turtle_num = as.numeric(gsub("\\D+", "", turtle_ID)),
    Sample_label = paste0(turtle_ID, "_", sample_type)
  )

sample_order <- df_phylum_ind %>%
  distinct(Sample_label, turtle_num, sample_type) %>%
  arrange(sample_type, turtle_num) %>%

df_phylum_ind$Sample_label <- factor(df_phylum_ind$Sample_label, levels = sample_order)

p_phylum_all <- ggplot(

) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scales = "free_x", nrow = 2) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phylum-level composition per sample",
    subtitle = "Samples ordered by turtle ID; colon and cloaca shown separately",
    x = "Turtle ID",
    y = "Relative abundance",

ggsave(
  "MW_Phylum_individual_all.png",

  width = 14,

ggsave(

  height = 8,

## Export phylum summary tables
top_phyla_tables <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(Abundance)),
    se_abundance = sd_abundance / sqrt(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rank <= 20) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(
  top_phyla_tables,
  "MW_Top20_Phyla_per_sample_type.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


## Paired Wilcoxon tests by phylum
df_phylum_clean <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(turtle_ID, sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

df_phylum_wide <- df_phylum_clean %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = Abundance
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colon) & !is.na(cloaca))

phylum_wilcox_results <- lapply(unique(df_phylum_wide$Phylum), function(p) {
  sub <- df_phylum_wide[df_phylum_wide$Phylum == p, ]

  test <- wilcox.test(
    sub$colon,
    sub$cloaca,
    paired = TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    Phylum = p,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

phylum_wilcox_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(phylum_wilcox_results$p_value, method = "BH")

phylum_means <- df_phylum_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample_type, values_from = mean_abundance)

phylum_stats <- phylum_wilcox_results %>%
  left_join(phylum_means, by = "Phylum") %>%
  mutate(
    higher_in = ifelse(colon > cloaca, "colon", "cloaca")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

phylum_stats

writexl::write_xlsx(
  phylum_stats,
  "MW_Wild_Phyla_Paired_Wilcoxon.xlsx"
)

#Merge tables
# Reshape abundance summary table to wide format
phylum_summary_wide <- top_phyla_tables %>%
  select(sample_type, Phylum, mean_abundance, sd_abundance, se_abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(mean_abundance, sd_abundance, se_abundance)
  )

# Merge summary abundances with paired Wilcoxon results
phylum_supp_table <- phylum_summary_wide %>%
  left_join(
    phylum_stats %>%
      select(Phylum, p_value, p_adj, higher_in),
    by = "Phylum"
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# View merged table
phylum_supp_table

# Save merged supplementary table
write.csv(
  phylum_supp_table,
  "MW_SuppTable_Phyla_Abundance_and_Wilcoxon.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  phylum_supp_table,
  "MW_SuppTable_Phyla_Abundance_and_Wilcoxon.xlsx"
)
```

##Genus
```{r}

topN <- 30

phy_genus_rel <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca")) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

df_genus <- psmelt(phy_genus_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = as.character(Genus),
    Genus = if_else(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus),
    sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("colon", "cloaca"))
  )


# 2. Summary stats + Wilcoxon 

# agglomaerat per turtle
df_genus_clean <- df_genus %>%
  group_by(turtle_ID, sample_type, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# Summary stats (mean ± SE)
genus_summary <- df_genus_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
    sd_abundance   = sd(Abundance),
    n_samples      = n(),
    se_abundance   = sd_abundance / sqrt(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pct = mean_abundance * 100,
    se_pct   = se_abundance * 100
  )

# Pivot summary to wide (colon vs cloaca side-by-side)
genus_summary_wide <- genus_summary %>%
  select(sample_type, Genus, mean_pct, se_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(mean_pct, se_pct)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Paired Wilcoxon
# -----------------------------
df_genus_wide <- df_genus_clean %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sample_type,
    values_from = Abundance
  ) %>%
  drop_na(colon, cloaca)

genus_wilcox <- df_genus_wide %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    test <- wilcox.test(.x$colon, .x$cloaca, paired = TRUE)
    tibble(p_value = test$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

# Mean values for direction + effect size
genus_means <- df_genus_wide %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    colon = mean(colon),
    cloaca = mean(cloaca),
    mean_diff = abs(colon - cloaca),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    higher_in = if_else(colon > cloaca, "colon", "cloaca")
  )


# final table
genus_final <- genus_summary_wide %>%
  left_join(genus_wilcox, by = "Genus") %>%
  left_join(genus_means, by = "Genus") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_diff))

# Top 50 + All genera

top50_genera <- genus_final %>%
  slice_head(n = 50)


# Export
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    Top50 = top50_genera,
    All_genera = genus_final
  ),
  "MW_Genus_Final_COLON_vs_CLOACA.xlsx"
)

#plot

# Identify the 30 most abundant genera across all samples

top_genera <- df_genus %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(Genus)


# Collapse remaining genera into "Other"

df_genus_plot <- df_genus %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_plot = if_else(
      Genus %in% top_genera,
      Genus,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    turtle_ID,
    sample_type,
    Genus_plot
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Keep turtles in numerical order

turtle_levels <- sort(
  unique(df_genus_plot$turtle_ID)
)

df_genus_plot <- df_genus_plot %>%
  mutate(
    turtle_ID = factor(
      turtle_ID,
      levels = turtle_levels
    ),
    sample_type = factor(
      sample_type,
      levels = c("cloaca", "colon"),
      labels = c("Cloaca", "Colon")
    )
  )


# Same genus colours used for both sample types

genus_levels <- c(
  "Other",
  sort(setdiff(
    unique(df_genus_plot$Genus_plot),
    "Other"
  ))
)

genus_palette <- c(
  "Other" = "#D9D9D9",
  setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(
      length(genus_levels) - 1
    ),
    genus_levels[-1]
  )
)

df_genus_plot$Genus_plot <- factor(
  df_genus_plot$Genus_plot,
  levels = genus_levels
)


#
# Genus plot for multipanel

topN <- 30

# Identify top genera
top_genera <- df_genus %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abund = mean(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(Genus)

# Collapse remaining genera into Other
df_genus_ind <- df_genus %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_plot = ifelse(
      Genus %in% top_genera,
      Genus,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    sample_type,
    turtle_ID,
    Genus_plot
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    turtle_num = as.numeric(turtle_ID),
    Sample_label = paste0(
      turtle_ID,
      "_",
      sample_type
    )
  )

# Cloaca on top, colon below
df_genus_ind <- df_genus_ind %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = factor(
      sample_type,
      levels = c("cloaca", "colon")
    )
  )

# Numeric turtle ordering
sample_order <- df_genus_ind %>%
  distinct(
    Sample_label,
    turtle_num,
    sample_type
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    sample_type,
    turtle_num
  ) %>%
  pull(Sample_label)

df_genus_ind$Sample_label <- factor(
  df_genus_ind$Sample_label,
  levels = sample_order
)

# Force Other to bottom of stack
df_genus_ind$Genus_plot <- factor(
  df_genus_ind$Genus_plot,
  levels = c(
    "Other",
    sort(
      setdiff(
        unique(df_genus_ind$Genus_plot),
        "Other"
      )
    )
  )
)

# Original pastel palette
base_pastel <- c(
  "#9AD0EC", "#FBC4AB", "#B5EAD7", "#FFAFCC", "#CDB4DB",

  "#FFD166", "#06D6A0", "#EF476F", "#118AB2", "#073B4C"
)

genus_levels <- levels(

genus_colors <- setNames(

  ) +

p_genus_multipanel

# Check that each sample sums to 100%

range(genus_plot_check$total)
```

#ANCOM
## Paired ANCOM ASV level
```{r}

# Paired ANCOM-BC2 analysis:
# Reference level: cloaca
# lfc_sample_typecolon:  positive = colon-enriched  negative = cloaca-enriched


# 1. subset


phy_asv <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(
    species == "EI" &
      grepl("^wild", status, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca") &
      !is.na(sample_type) &
      !is.na(turtle_ID)
  )

phy_asv <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(phy_asv) > 0,
  phy_asv
)

phy_asv <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_asv) > 0,
  phy_asv
)



# 2. set factors

sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type <- factor(
  as.character(sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type),
  levels = c("cloaca", "colon")
)

sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID <- factor(
  as.character(sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID)
)


# 3. Confirm each turtle has colon and cloaca sample


pair_table <- table(
  sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID,
  sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type
)

print(pair_table)

complete_pairs <- rownames(pair_table)[
  pair_table[, "cloaca"] == 1 &
    pair_table[, "colon"] == 1
]

cat(
  "\nNumber of complete turtle pairs:",
  length(complete_pairs),
  "\n"
)

cat("Samples retained:", nsamples(phy_asv), "\n")
cat("ASVs before ANCOM-BC2 filtering:", ntaxa(phy_asv), "\n")
print(table(sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type))

# 4. paired ANCOM-BC2
# sample_type = fixed effect
# turtle_ID   = random intercept

set.seed(123)

ancom_asv <- ancombc2(
  data = phy_asv,
  assay_name = "otu_table",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "sample_type",
  rand_formula = "(1 | turtle_ID)",
  group = "sample_type",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  lib_cut = 1000,
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Save object
saveRDS(
  ancom_asv,
  "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_model.rds"
)


# 5. Extract modeled ANCOM-BC2 results


                # Verify columns
required_columns <- c(
  
  "taxon",
  
  "lfc_sample_typecolon",
  
  "se_sample_typecolon",
  
  "p_sample_typecolon",
  
  "q_sample_typecolon",
  
  "passed_ss_sample_typecolon",
  
  "diff_sample_typecolon",
  
  "diff_robust_sample_typecolon"
  
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  
  required_columns,
  
  colnames(ancom_asv$res)
  
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  
  stop(
    
    "Missing expected result columns: ",
    
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    
  )
  
}

           # extract results

required_columns <- c(
  "taxon",
  "lfc_sample_typecolon",
  "se_sample_typecolon",
  "p_sample_typecolon",
  "q_sample_typecolon",
  "passed_ss_sample_typecolon",
  "diff_sample_typecolon",
  "diff_robust_sample_typecolon"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(ancom_asv$res)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing expected result columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

res_asv <- ancom_asv$res %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(taxon),
    logFC = lfc_sample_typecolon,
    se = se_sample_typecolon,
    p_val = p_sample_typecolon,
    q_val = q_sample_typecolon,
    passed_ss = passed_ss_sample_typecolon,
    diff_abn = diff_sample_typecolon,
    diff_robust = diff_robust_sample_typecolon
  )



# 6. Attach taxonomy 

tax_df <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(phy_asv),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

res_asv <- res_asv %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      any_of(c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")),
      ~na_if(as.character(.x), "Unclassified")
    ),
    Label = case_when(
      !is.na(Genus) & Genus != "" ~
        paste0(Genus, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Family) & Family != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Family, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Order) & Order != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Order, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Class) & Class != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Class, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Phylum) & Phylum != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Phylum, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      TRUE ~ ASV
    ),
    
    # Direction depends only on coefficient sign.
    direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 ~ "Colon-enriched",
      logFC < 0 ~ "Cloaca-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )



# 7. Create result set containing significant after BH and robust sensitivity (ANCOM SS FILTER)


# BH-significant modeled ASVs
sig_asv <- res_asv %>%
  filter(
    diff_abn %in% TRUE,
    !is.na(logFC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_val)

# Significant ASVs that also pass pseudo-count sensitivity
sig_asv_robust <- res_asv %>%
  filter(
    diff_robust %in% TRUE,
    !is.na(logFC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_val)



# 8. Summarize results

cat("\nASVs modeled:", nrow(res_asv), "\n")
cat("BH-significant modeled ASVs:", nrow(sig_asv), "\n")
cat(
  "Pseudo-count-robust significant ASVs:",
  nrow(sig_asv_robust),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nBH-significant ASVs by direction:\n")
print(sig_asv %>% count(direction))

cat("\nRobust significant ASVs by direction:\n")
print(sig_asv_robust %>% count(direction))


# 9. Extract structural-zero ASVs (many of them might be bioloigcal important as they are almost absent in one of the sample types)


zero_asv <- ancom_asv$zero_ind %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(taxon),
    
    direction = case_when(
      `structural_zero (sample_type = cloaca)` %in% TRUE &
        !(`structural_zero (sample_type = colon)` %in% TRUE) ~
        "Colon-associated",
      
      `structural_zero (sample_type = colon)` %in% TRUE &
        !(`structural_zero (sample_type = cloaca)` %in% TRUE) ~
        "Cloaca-associated",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  select(-taxon) %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV")

cat("\nStructural-zero ASVs by direction:\n")
print(zero_asv %>% count(direction))


# 10. Add prevalence and abundance to structural zeros to determine the most important ones 
# Subset to structural-zero ASVs before converting to long format to reduce memory use.


otu_zero <- as(
  otu_table(phy_asv),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_asv)) {
  otu_zero <- t(otu_zero)
}

zero_ids <- intersect(
  zero_asv$ASV,
  rownames(otu_zero)
)

otu_zero <- otu_zero[zero_ids, , drop = FALSE]

meta_zero <- data.frame(
  sample_data(phy_asv),
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name")

zero_counts_long <- as.data.frame(otu_zero) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_zero %>%
      select(
        sample_name,
        turtle_ID,
        sample_type
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  )

zero_summary <- zero_counts_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_detected = sum(count > 0),
    prevalence = mean(count > 0),
    mean_count = mean(count),
    median_count = median(count),
    total_count = sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(
      n_samples,
      n_detected,
      prevalence,
      mean_count,
      median_count,
      total_count
    ),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

zero_asv_full <- zero_asv %>%
  left_join(zero_summary, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ prevalence_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ prevalence_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    mean_count_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ mean_count_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ mean_count_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    total_count_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ total_count_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ total_count_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )



# 11. Rank structural-zero ASVs as they do not have p values


top_structural_zero <- zero_asv_full %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),
    desc(mean_count_present_group)
  )

top_structural_zero_by_direction <- zero_asv_full %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),
    desc(mean_count_present_group),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

print(
  top_structural_zero %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      Genus,
      direction,
      prevalence_cloaca,
      prevalence_colon,
      mean_count_cloaca,
      mean_count_colon
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)


# 12. Export complete supplementary table with ancom and structural zero results


write_xlsx(
  list(
    All_modelled_ASVs = res_asv,
    Significant_modelled_ASVs = sig_asv,
    Robust_significant_ASVs = sig_asv_robust,
    All_structural_zero_ASVs = zero_asv_full,
    Top_structural_zeros = top_structural_zero,
    Top_10_zeros_by_direction =
      top_structural_zero_by_direction
  ),
  "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_complete.xlsx"
)


############################################
# 13. Select ASVs for Figure 3C
#
# 4 modeled ASVs per direction = 8 bars
# 2 structural-zero ASVs per direction = 4 diamonds
# Total = 12 ASVs


# 13A. Select ANCOM model ASVs:  Rank by absolute estimated log fold change.


modelled_for_figure <- sig_asv_robust %>%

    !is.na(logFC),

  ) %>%

  ) %>%

  )



# 13B. Select structural-zero ASVs
#Rank first by prevalence, then by mean abundance

zero_for_figure <- zero_asv_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),

          " (",
          ASV,
          "; SZ)"
        ),
      
      TRUE ~ paste0(ASV, " (SZ)")
    ),
    
    result_type = "Structural zero"
  )



# 14. Define structural-zero marker positions
# Structural-zero markers are placed just outside the modeled logFC range. Their position indicates direction, not numerical effect size.
max_abs_logFC <- max(
  abs(modelled_for_figure$logFC),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

structural_zero_position <- max_abs_logFC * 1.15

zero_for_figure <- zero_for_figure %>%

label_levels <- plot_order$Plot_label

modelled_for_figure <- modelled_for_figure %>%

zero_for_figure <- zero_for_figure %>%

# 16. Plot combined ANCOM-BC2 results

  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(

    )

print(p_ancom_asv)
```

#Venn
```{r}
## VENN ANALYSIS
# Taxonomic overlap between colon and cloaca
# Primary analysis: ASVs retained if prevalence >=10% in colon OR cloaca
# Sensitivity analysis: 5% prevalence threshold

# Prepare abundance and metadata

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(phy_mw), "matrix")

if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_mw)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

meta_df <- as(sample_data(phy_mw), "data.frame")

colon_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[
  meta_df$sample_type == "colon"
]

cloaca_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[
  meta_df$sample_type == "cloaca"
]

stopifnot(
  length(colon_samples) == 48,
  length(cloaca_samples) == 48
)


# Calculate ASV prevalence within each sample type

prevalence_table <- tibble(
  ASV = rownames(otu_mat),
  n_colon = rowSums(
    otu_mat[, colon_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0
  ),
  n_cloaca = rowSums(
    otu_mat[, cloaca_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence_colon = n_colon / length(colon_samples),
    prevalence_cloaca = n_cloaca / length(cloaca_samples)
  )


# Function for prevalence-filtered ASV overlap

calculate_overlap <- function(prevalence_df, threshold) {
  
  filtered <- prevalence_df %>%
    filter(
      prevalence_colon >= threshold |
        prevalence_cloaca >= threshold
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_group = case_when(
        n_colon > 0 & n_cloaca > 0 ~ "Shared",
        n_colon > 0 & n_cloaca == 0 ~ "Colon only",
        n_colon == 0 & n_cloaca > 0 ~ "Cloaca only"
      )
    )
  
  summary <- filtered %>%
    count(
      overlap_group,
      name = "Number_of_ASVs"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Prevalence_threshold = paste0(threshold * 100, "%"),
      Percentage = round(
        100 * Number_of_ASVs / sum(Number_of_ASVs),
        1
      )
    )
  
  list(
    filtered_asvs = filtered,
    summary = summary
  )
}


# Primary 10% analysis

overlap_10 <- calculate_overlap(
  prevalence_table,
  threshold = 0.10
)

overlap_asv <- overlap_10$filtered_asvs

print(overlap_10$summary)


# Sensitivity analysis at 5%

overlap_5 <- calculate_overlap(
  prevalence_table,
  threshold = 0.05
)

print(overlap_5$summary)


# Combine 5% and 10% sensitivity results

# Function to calculate taxonomic overlap

get_overlap <- function(colon_set, cloaca_set) {
  
  tibble(
    colon_only = length(
      setdiff(colon_set, cloaca_set)
    ),
    shared = length(
      intersect(colon_set, cloaca_set)
    ),
    cloaca_only = length(
      setdiff(cloaca_set, colon_set)
    )
  )
}


# Primary overlap totals

overlap_phylum <- get_overlap(
  phylum_colon,
  phylum_cloaca
)

overlap_family <- get_overlap(
  family_colon,
  family_cloaca
)

overlap_ASV <- get_overlap(
  asv_colon,
  asv_cloaca
)

print(overlap_phylum)
print(overlap_family)
print(overlap_ASV)

print(overlap_totals)

# Proportional Venn-style plotting function
# Circle AREA is proportional to number of taxa detected in each sample type

make_proportional_venn <- function(
    counts,
    panel_label,
    level_label,
    shared_pos = 0.15,
    colon_only_pos = -0.55
) {
  
  colon_only  <- counts$colon_only
  shared      <- counts$shared
  cloaca_only <- counts$cloaca_only
  
  colon_total  <- colon_only + shared
  cloaca_total <- cloaca_only + shared
  union_total  <- colon_only + shared + cloaca_only
  
  r_cloaca <- 1.35
  r_colon <- r_cloaca *
    sqrt(colon_total / cloaca_total)
  
  y_cloaca <- 0.35
  
  y_colon <- y_cloaca -
    r_cloaca +
    r_colon * 0.55
  
  pct <- function(x) {
    paste0(
      round(100 * x / union_total, 1),
      "%"
    )
  }
  
  ggplot() +
    
    geom_circle(
      aes(
        x0 = 0,
        y0 = y_cloaca,
        r = r_cloaca
      ),
      fill = "#D8C7F0",
      colour = "#7B1FA2",
      alpha = 0.55,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    
    geom_circle(
      aes(
        x0 = 0,
        y0 = y_colon,
        r = r_colon
      ),
      fill = "#CFE8D6",
      colour = "#4E8B5C",
      alpha = 0.60,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -1.55,
      y = 2.35,
      label = panel_label,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5,
      hjust = 0
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 2.35,
      label = level_label,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = y_cloaca + r_cloaca + 0.12,
      label = "Cloaca",
      colour = "#7B1FA2",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.3
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = y_colon - r_colon - 0.15,
      label = "Colon",
      colour = "#4E8B5C",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.3
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = y_cloaca + 0.48 * r_cloaca,
      label = paste0(
        cloaca_only,
        "\n(",
        pct(cloaca_only),
        ")"
      ),
      size = 3.8,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = y_colon + shared_pos * r_colon,
      label = paste0(
        shared,
        "\n(",
        pct(shared),
        ")"
      ),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.8,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = y_colon + colon_only_pos * r_colon,
      label = paste0(
        colon_only,
        "\n(",
        pct(colon_only),
        ")"
      ),
      size = 3.8,
      lineheight = 1.1
    ) +
    
    coord_fixed(
      xlim = c(-1.7, 1.7),
      ylim = c(-2.05, 2.55),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    
    theme_void() +
    
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 5,
        b = 5,
        l = 5
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
phy_mw

#1. Good coverage
##Good’s coverage estimates the proportion of the sampled community represented by ASVs that were observed more than once
#If I sequence one additional read from this sample, what is the estimated probability that it belongs to an ASV that has already been observed?

# Extract ASV count matrix with samples as rows
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(phy_mw), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(phy_mw)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

# Calculate Good's coverage for each sample:
# C = 1 - (number of singleton ASVs / total reads)

goods_coverage <- apply(otu_mat, 1, function(x) {
  N  <- sum(x)
  f1 <- sum(x == 1)
  1 - (f1 / N)
})

# Create sample-level results table
coverage_df <- data.frame(
  sample_ID = names(goods_coverage),
  goods_coverage = as.numeric(goods_coverage)
)

# Add sample type
meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_mw))

meta_df$sample_ID <- rownames(meta_df)

coverage_df <- coverage_df %>%
  left_join(
    meta_df %>% select(sample_ID, sample_type),
    by = "sample_ID"
  )

# Express coverage as percentage as well
coverage_df <- coverage_df %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_percent = goods_coverage * 100
  )

# Inspect all samples
coverage_df %>%
  arrange(goods_coverage)

# Summary by sample type
coverage_summary <- coverage_df %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_coverage = mean(goods_coverage),
    sd_coverage = sd(goods_coverage),
    median_coverage = median(goods_coverage),
    min_coverage = min(goods_coverage),
    max_coverage = max(goods_coverage),
    mean_percent = mean(coverage_percent),
    median_percent = median(coverage_percent),
    min_percent = min(coverage_percent),
    max_percent = max(coverage_percent)
  )

coverage_summary

# ============================================================
# 2. REPEATED RAREFACTION ACROSS SEQUENCING DEPTHS
# ============================================================

# Use manuscript-filtered, unrarefied dataset
phy_depth <- phy_mw

# Add turtle ID from sample name
sample_data(phy_depth)$turtle_ID <- sub(
  "^(EI[0-9]+).*",
  "\\1",
  sample_names(phy_depth)
)

# Check pairing
table(sample_data(phy_depth)$sample_type)
table(table(sample_data(phy_depth)$turtle_ID))

# Sequencing depths to test
depths <- c(20000, 30000, 40000, 45000)

# Number of repeated rarefactions
n_iter <- 100

set.seed(42)

depth_results <- list()

counter <- 1

for (depth in depths) {
  
  message("Starting depth: ", depth)
  
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    
    # Independently rarefy all samples
    phy_r <- rarefy_even_depth(
      phy_depth,
      sample.size = depth,
      rngseed = sample.int(1e8, 1),
      replace = FALSE,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Calculate alpha diversity
    alpha_r <- estimate_richness(
      phy_r,
      measures = c("Observed", "Shannon")
    )
    
    alpha_r$sample_ID <- rownames(alpha_r)
    
    # Add metadata
    meta_r <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_r))
    meta_r$sample_ID <- rownames(meta_r)
    
    alpha_r <- alpha_r %>%
      left_join(
        meta_r %>%
          select(sample_ID, sample_type, turtle_ID),
        by = "sample_ID"
      )
    
    # Convert to paired wide format
    paired_r <- alpha_r %>%
      select(turtle_ID, sample_type, Observed, Shannon) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = sample_type,
        values_from = c(Observed, Shannon)
      )
    
    # Store summary for this iteration
    depth_results[[counter]] <- data.frame(
      depth = depth,
      iteration = i,
      
      median_observed_colon =
        median(paired_r$Observed_colon),
      
      median_observed_cloaca =
        median(paired_r$Observed_cloaca),
      
      median_observed_difference =
        median(
          paired_r$Observed_cloaca -
            paired_r$Observed_colon
        ),
      
      median_shannon_colon =
        median(paired_r$Shannon_colon),
      
      median_shannon_cloaca =
        median(paired_r$Shannon_cloaca),
      
      median_shannon_difference =
        median(
          paired_r$Shannon_cloaca -
            paired_r$Shannon_colon
        ),
      
      p_observed =
        wilcox.test(
          paired_r$Observed_cloaca,
          paired_r$Observed_colon,
          paired = TRUE,
          exact = FALSE
        )$p.value,
      
      p_shannon =
        wilcox.test(
          paired_r$Shannon_cloaca,
          paired_r$Shannon_colon,
          paired = TRUE,
          exact = FALSE
        )$p.value
    )
    
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# Combine all 400 results
depth_results <- bind_rows(depth_results)

  reads = sample_sums(phy_mw),
  sample_type = as.character(sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type)
)

depth_df$turtle_ID <- sub(
  "^(EI[0-9]+).*",
  "\\1",
  depth_df$sample_ID
)

pair_depths <- depth_df %>%
  select(turtle_ID, sample_type, reads) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = reads
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    minimum_pair_depth = pmin(colon, cloaca)
  )

sapply(
  c(50000, 60000, 70000, 80000, 90000),
  function(x) sum(pair_depths$minimum_pair_depth >= x)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3A. Complete pairs with >=60,000 reads in BOTH samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ids_60k <- pair_depths %>%
  filter(minimum_pair_depth >= 60000) %>%
  pull(turtle_ID)

depth_df <- data.frame(
  sample_ID = sample_names(phy_mw),
  reads = sample_sums(phy_mw),
  sample_type = as.character(sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type)
)

depth_df$turtle_ID <- sub(
  "^(EI[0-9]+).*",
  "\\1",
  depth_df$sample_ID
)

pair_depths <- depth_df %>%
  select(turtle_ID, sample_type, reads) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = reads
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    minimum_pair_depth = pmin(colon, cloaca)
  )

sapply(
  c(50000, 60000, 70000, 80000, 90000),
  function(x) sum(pair_depths$minimum_pair_depth >= x)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3A. Complete pairs with >=60,000 reads in BOTH samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ids_60k <- pair_depths %>%
  filter(minimum_pair_depth >= 60000) %>%
  pull(turtle_ID)

phy_60k <- prune_samples(
  sample_data(phy_depth)$turtle_ID %in% ids_60k,
  phy_depth
)

phy_60k <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_60k) > 0,
  phy_60k
)

# Check retained design
nsamples(phy_60k)
table(sample_data(phy_60k)$sample_type)
table(table(sample_data(phy_60k)$turtle_ID))
summary(sample_sums(phy_60k))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3B. Repeated rarefaction of high-depth pairs to 60,000 reads
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(42)

results_60k <- vector("list", 100)

for (i in 1:100) {
  
  phy_r <- rarefy_even_depth(
    phy_60k,
    sample.size = 60000,
    rngseed = sample.int(1e8, 1),
    replace = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  alpha_r <- estimate_richness(
    phy_r,
    measures = c("Observed", "Shannon")
  )
  
  alpha_r$sample_ID <- rownames(alpha_r)
  
  meta_r <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_r))
  meta_r$sample_ID <- rownames(meta_r)
  
  alpha_r <- alpha_r %>%
    left_join(
      meta_r %>%
        select(sample_ID, sample_type, turtle_ID),
      by = "sample_ID"
    )
  
  paired_r <- alpha_r %>%
    select(turtle_ID, sample_type, Observed, Shannon) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_type,
      values_from = c(Observed, Shannon)
    )
  
  results_60k[[i]] <- data.frame(
    iteration = i,
    
    observed_colon = median(paired_r$Observed_colon),
    observed_cloaca = median(paired_r$Observed_cloaca),
    
    observed_difference = median(
      paired_r$Observed_cloaca -
        paired_r$Observed_colon
    ),
    
    shannon_colon = median(paired_r$Shannon_colon),
    shannon_cloaca = median(paired_r$Shannon_cloaca),
    
    shannon_difference = median(
      paired_r$Shannon_cloaca -
        paired_r$Shannon_colon
    ),
    
    p_observed = wilcox.test(
      paired_r$Observed_cloaca,
      paired_r$Observed_colon,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    
    p_shannon = wilcox.test(
      paired_r$Shannon_cloaca,
      paired_r$Shannon_colon,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  )
}

results_60k <- bind_rows(results_60k)

# SAVE IMMEDIATELY
saveRDS(
  results_60k,
  "Reviewer4_highdepth_60k_results.rds"
)

dim(results_60k)

summary_60k <- results_60k %>%
  summarise(
    observed_colon_median = median(observed_colon),
    observed_cloaca_median = median(observed_cloaca),
    
    observed_difference_median = median(observed_difference),
    observed_difference_min = min(observed_difference),
    observed_difference_max = max(observed_difference),
    
    shannon_colon_median = median(shannon_colon),
    shannon_cloaca_median = median(shannon_cloaca),
    
    shannon_difference_median = median(shannon_difference),
    shannon_difference_min = min(shannon_difference),
    shannon_difference_max = max(shannon_difference),
    
    max_p_observed = max(p_observed),
    max_p_shannon = max(p_shannon)
  )

print(summary_60k)

nrow(results_60k)

length(unique(results_60k$observed_difference))
length(unique(results_60k$shannon_difference))

head(results_60k, 10)

      n_pairs = 48,

    ),
  
  summary_80k %>%
```
